hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; pnpm exec oxfmt "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [[ "$f" == *.ts ]] && pnpm exec oxlint "$f" 2>&1 | tail -5; } || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | grep -q '\.ts-suppressions\.json' && echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Do not edit .ts-suppressions.json directly — use the suppress or update commands"}' && exit 1 || exit 0
